sanskrit:
देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा ।
तथा देहान्तरप्राप्ति र्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥ २-१३॥
iast:
dehino’sminyathā dehe kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā
tathā dehāntaraprāptir dhīrastatra na muhyati 2-13
translation: Just as in this body the embodied (soul) passes into childhood, youth and old age, so also does he pass into another body; the firm man does not grieve at it.
